parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Allowed: id, sku, faire_variant_id, wholesale_price, created_at. Prefix with `-` for descending.

parameters.name: filter[archived]
parameters.description: 0 = active variants only (default), 1 = archived only. Omit to include both.

parameters.name: filter[mapped.is]
parameters.description: 1 = only variants linked to a sku.io product. 0 = only unmapped. Operator suffix (`.is`) matches the advanced-filter checkbox convention.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Free-text search across sku, faire_variant_id, name (uses AdvancedSearchFilter)

parameters.name: filter[status][is]
parameters.description: Faire product status: ACTIVE | INACTIVE | DRAFT | DELETED

parameters.name: filter[product_type][is]
parameters.description: Faire taxonomy product_type (e.g. "Bar Tool"). Powered by the filter-options endpoint.

parameters.name: filter[has_sku.is]
parameters.description: 1 = variants with a Faire SKU. 0 = variants missing a SKU. Operator suffix (`.is`) matches the advanced-filter checkbox convention.

parameters.name: filter[date_from]
parameters.description: Created on/after this date (any parseable date string)
